card.name: Defining a unit as equal to another
card.fires_on: Words that set up an equivalence or define one unit, such as '=', 'is equivalent to', 'one unit', or 'cycle' and 'complete' in a definition. Seen where a quantity or a cycle is being defined.

modes.label: Equals sign in conversions
modes.description: The equals sign or linking word between two equivalent amounts.

modes.label: Defining a cycle
modes.description: The word cycle or complete when explaining what one full cycle is.
modes.example: A<< cycle>> is one push of the Syringe A

modes.label: Unit equivalence wording
modes.description: Words like is, one, or unit that introduce an equivalent amount.
modes.example: - 1<< unit>> of alcohol contains 8g of alcohol

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning 'equivalent to', 'a whole set', and 'cycle' or 'iteration'.
card.plain: It fires where the text defines one amount or one cycle as equal to something else.
